The Linux and macOS downloads run again, and a release only goes public once its downloads are on it.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **The Linux and macOS zips hold a program that starts.** The desktop bundles travelled through a build artifact before they were zipped, and an artifact drops file modes, so `KnightLoader` on Linux and the executable inside `KnightLoader.app` on macOS came out of the zip without their execute bit. They are zipped on the machine that builds them now.

## ⚡ Improved

- **A release goes public only with its downloads attached.** It used to appear twenty minutes and more before its zips, and in that time the download buttons and the in-app update check found a release with nothing on it.
- **"Latest" goes only to the newest published version**, on the release and on both container images alike, so a re-cut of an older version no longer pulls them back.
